hero.title: Buy it as it is, or make it yours.
hero.description: Shop ready-to-wear from independent designers and tailors, with your size suggested from your measurements. Or customize the piece and have it made to them.

customize.title: Change the styles, see the price
customize.description: Each part of the outfit starts on a style already included in the price. Pick another neckline or sleeve and you see exactly what it adds.
points: The price updates as you choose
Preview your outfit before you buy, if you like

fit.title: Made to your measurements
fit.description: Choose how it should fit and the length, then pick which of your saved measurements it's made to. Not sure? Let the tailor decide and talk it over.
points: Any of your saved measurement sets
Get measured in about a minute if you haven't yet

cart.title: Every naira, accounted for
cart.description: Your cart breaks each outfit's price down: the base, the styles you chose and any fabric of your own, before you check out.
points: Base, styles and fabric shown separately
Use your own fabric on pieces that allow it
Edit a piece from the cart

closing.title: Ready to wear, or made your way.
closing.description: Join the waitlist to shop ready-to-wear and customize it to your measurements.
